instruction: You are the maintenance planner for Northstar Controls. Resolve FACTORYBENCH-021 (Open repair for a failed servo drive). Correlate the alarm email, technician Slack thread, fault-history export, and service manual before opening the high-priority asset work order. The case is an isolated snapshot as of 2026-01-12; correlate immutable IDs and effective revisions rather than matching names alone. Evidence is distributed across Oracle Fusion, Gmail, Drive, Sheets, and Slack, with inspectable files including `operating-policy.md`, `contract-or-service-control.md`, `supplier-quotation.pdf`, `supplier-lead-time-and-capacity.xlsx`, `approval-decision-log.csv`, `source-email-thread.eml`, `operations-slack-thread.json`, `drive-approval-record.json`. After the documented Oracle operation, record the current reviewer's Drive approval; then append an audit row to the control workbook. Return exactly: maintenance_order, asset_or_resource, planned_finish.
